verdict.rationale: Runpod documents the full lifecycle without the console. runpodctl can create, start, stop, and terminate Pods (e.g. `runpodctl pod create --gpu-id ... --image ...`). The REST API v1 covers all compute resources, GraphQL can create, start, stop, and query Pods, and official MCP servers plus agent skills let coding agents create Pods and deploy workloads. Workloads run through SSH, Flash remote functions, or Serverless SDKs. missing for 10: explicit monitoring/metrics/log-retrieval docs beyond querying Pods and 'diagnose issues', a machine-readable OpenAPI spec (probed paths 404), and independent hands-on corroboration of an agent running the flow end to end.
